```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
```

## Introduction

This is a short report about the **Palmer Penguins** dataset.
The data contains measurements for three penguin species:

- *Adelie*
- *Chinstrap*
- *Gentoo*

You can find more information about the data on the
[palmerpenguins website](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/).[^1]

::: {.callout-note}
The `penguins` data is included in R since version 4.5.0, so you don't need to install a package to use it.
:::

## Data overview

The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` penguins from `r length(unique(penguins$species))` species.
@tbl-penguins shows the mean body mass and flipper length of each species.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-penguins
#| tbl-cap: "Mean body mass and flipper length of the three penguin species."
penguins |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    body_mass = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    flipper_len = mean(flipper_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = species
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Species", "n", "Body mass (g)", "Flipper length (mm)")
  )
```

## Analysis

@fig-bill shows the relationship between bill length and bill depth.

```{r}
#| label: fig-bill
#| fig-cap: "Bill length and bill depth of the three penguin species."
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "80%"
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_len, y = bill_dep, color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

[^1]: The data was collected by Dr. Kristen Gorman at Palmer Station, Antarctica.
